# vendored TLS client

`reclaim-tls.bundle.js` is a minified bundle of `@reclaimprotocol/tls@0.1.5`,
including its WebCrypto implementation. It is used only for HTTPS subscription
servers that require a custom SNI while connecting to an IP address.

Source: https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/tls
License: MIT (see `LICENSE.reclaim-tls.txt`)
